title_en: Shaanxi Province Weinan City People's Procuratorate v. Weinan Youhu Tower Garden Co., Ltd., Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda — case of illegally absorbing public deposits and Hui Qingxiang's misappropriation of funds
ruling_gist_en: Without approval from the People's Bank of China, absorbing funds from unspecified members of the public not under the guise of absorbing public deposits, but promising obligations of the same nature as absorbing public deposits, i.e., promising to repay principal and interest within a certain period, constitutes the 'disguised absorption of public deposits' as stipulated in Article 176 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. As long as the actor has committed the act of illegally absorbing public deposits, regardless of the means or methods adopted for such illegal absorption, it does not affect the establishment of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.
keywords_en: criminal; illegal absorption of public deposits; misappropriation of funds; first instance; intermediate people's court; Shaanxi Province; legal person; natural person; criminal law; determination of disguised absorption of public deposits; composition of the crime of misappropriation of funds; false publicity; tower niche sales
full_text_en:
People's Procuratorate of Weinan City, Shaanxi Province v.

Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd., Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda — Dispute over Illegal Absorption of Public Deposits, and Hui Qingxiang — Misappropriation of Funds

**Ruling Summary**

Where a party, without approval from the People's Bank of China, absorbs funds from an unspecified public audience not in the name of absorbing public deposits, but promises to perform obligations of the same nature as those of absorbing public deposits, i.e., promises to repay principal and interest within a specified period, such conduct constitutes "disguised absorption of public deposits" as stipulated in Article 176 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. As long as a person has engaged in the act of illegally absorbing public deposits, regardless of the means or methods used for such illegal absorption, it does not affect the establishment of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

Procuratorial Authority: People's Procuratorate of Weinan City, Shaanxi Province.

Defendant Unit: Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd., domiciled at Dongfeng Street, Weinan City.

Legal Representative: Xu Yueshan, male, 50 years old, Deputy General Manager of the company.

Defendant: Hui Qingxiang, male, 52 years old, former Chairman and General Manager of Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd., residing at Changqiao Community, Lihu Street, Binhu District, Wuxi City. He was criminally detained on October 31, 2006 on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits, and was lawfully arrested on November 16 of the same year.

Defendant: Chen Chuang, male, 31 years old, former Executive Deputy General Manager and Marketing Manager of Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd., residing at Daxuigou, Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province. He was criminally detained on October 13, 2006 on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits, and was lawfully arrested on November 2 of the same year.

Defendant: Feng Zhenda, male, 36 years old, former Marketing Director of Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd., residing at Junjing Garden, No. 190 Zhongshan Avenue, Guangzhou City. He was criminally detained on September 22, 2006 on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits, and was lawfully arrested on November 2 of the same year.

The People's Procuratorate of Weinan City, Shaanxi Province, initiated a public prosecution with the Weinan Intermediate People's Court, Shaanxi Province, against the defendant unit Weinan Youhu Tower Park Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Youhu Tower Park Company) and the defendants Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits, and against Hui Qingxiang for the crime of misappropriating funds.

The indictment alleged: The defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was registered and established in Weinan City, Shaanxi Province on July 7, 1998. To resolve its funding problems, under the manipulation of the defendants Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda, the company engaged in false advertising to the public, falsely claiming that the tower spaces used for placing the ashes of the deceased could appreciate in value. Using means such as irregularly increasing tower space prices and promising repurchase, the company deceived and induced members of the public to purchase tower spaces, thereby massively and illegally absorbing public funds. The number of victims in the Xi'an area who were deceived into purchasing the company's tower spaces reached 4,334 persons, from whom the company illegally absorbed over RMB 96.98 million in public funds. Additionally, to address the shortage of funds at Youhu Tower Park Company, Hui Qingxiang also decided to illegally borrow funds at high interest rates from the company's internal employees and the general public. From December 1998 to July 2006, a total of over RMB 10.98 million was borrowed. In total, Youhu Tower Park Company illegally absorbed over RMB 107 million in public deposits. Hui Qingxiang, as the General Manager of the company, led, organized, and participated in all criminal activities and was the directly responsible supervisor; Chen Chuang, as the Executive Deputy General Manager and Marketing Manager, organized and participated in the illegal absorption of RMB 96.98 million in public deposits and was a directly responsible person; Feng Zhenda participated in the illegal absorption of over RMB 26.32 million in public deposits and was a directly responsible person.

On November 10, 2003 and August 30, 2004, the defendant Hui Qingxiang twice instructed the defendant Chen Chuang to transfer RMB 4 million from the proceeds of tower space sales of the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company to the personal account of Qiu Jianxiong in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, as an investment for the joint operation of "Yijiangnan Catering Co., Ltd." by Hui Qingxiang's wife Ge Lihua and Qiu Jianxiong. After the case was uncovered, RMB 2 million of the misappropriated funds were recovered.

The defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company, without approval from the People's Bank of China, used false advertising and other means, with the lure of high returns, to illegally absorb over RMB 107 million in public funds from an unspecified public audience. The amount was especially huge and seriously disrupted the national financial management order. Its conduct violated the provisions of Article 176 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law) and constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. The defendant Hui Qingxiang, as the directly responsible supervisor, and the defendants Chen Chuang and Feng Zhenda, as directly responsible persons, should be convicted and punished for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits according to law. Hui Qingxiang also used his position to misappropriate company funds for profit-making activities, with an especially huge amount. His conduct violated the provisions of Article 272 of the Criminal Law and constituted the crime of misappropriating funds. The above defendants should be held criminally liable according to law. In view of the fact that the defendant Chen Chuang had meritorious performance, it was recommended that he be given a lighter punishment according to law.

The defense counsel for the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company argued: The borrowing from enterprises and the sale of tower spaces to the public by Youhu Tower Park Company were normal market activities. Youhu Tower Park Company had reported the price of tower space sales to the Weinan Price Bureau for review, and the bureau agreed in writing. Therefore, the above conduct of Youhu Tower Park Company did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. This case was a civil dispute and should be resolved through civil procedure.

The defendant Hui Qingxiang argued: First, the sale of tower spaces by the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was a normal market activity and not an illegal absorption of public deposits. Moreover, after assessment, the assets of Youhu Tower Park Company were fully able to repay customer funds. As the person in charge of the company, leading and organizing the sale of tower spaces by Youhu Tower Park Company was his normal performance of duties and did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. Second, according to his agreement with the cooperation partners, he had full authority over the operation and management of Youhu Tower Park Company, so he had the right to use the company's funds, and his use of company funds did not constitute the crime of misappropriating funds.

The defense counsel for the defendant Hui Qingxiang argued: The sale of tower spaces by the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was approved by the civil affairs department. The company's sale of tower spaces to customers and borrowing from individuals and enterprises were market activities and did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. Therefore, Hui Qingxiang's conduct in this case also did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. According to the agreement signed between Hui Qingxiang and Weinan Shefu Industry and Trade Company, Hui Qingxiang was fully responsible for the operation and management of Youhu Tower Park Company. Therefore, Hui Qingxiang had the right to decide on the use of the company's funds, and his use of the company's funds did not constitute the crime of misappropriating funds. Additionally, after being brought to justice, Hui Qingxiang voluntarily disclosed to the public security authorities the facts regarding the investment in "Yijiangnan Catering Co., Ltd." Even if such conduct constituted the crime of misappropriating funds, it should be recognized that Hui Qingxiang had surrendered himself and should be given a lighter punishment according to law.

The defendant Chen Chuang argued: His conduct in the normal performance of his duties at the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The defense counsel for the defendant Chen Chuang argued: Although Chen Chuang was the person in charge of the Xi'an region of the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company, he only played a coordinating role in the sale of tower spaces and had a minor role in this case. Additionally, Chen Chuang reported to the public security authorities information about the defendant Hui Qingxiang's crime of misappropriating funds, which constituted meritorious performance. It was recommended that Chen Chuang be given a mitigated punishment and a suspended sentence.

The defendant Feng Zhenda argued: The sale of tower spaces to the public by the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was a normal market activity, and his conduct was entirely in the performance of his duties, so he did not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The defense counsel for the defendant Feng Zhenda argued: The sale of tower spaces by the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was a normal market activity. The disputes between customers and the company were civil disputes. The company did not illegally absorb public deposits, and the Criminal Law did not explicitly categorize such conduct as disguised absorption of public deposits. Furthermore, Feng Zhenda was no longer an employee of Youhu Tower Park Company and was not a directly responsible person. Therefore, Feng Zhenda did not constitute the crime of misappropriating funds.

The Weinan Intermediate People's Court found through trial:

The defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company was formally registered and established with the Weinan Administration for Industry and Commerce on July 7, 1998, through a partnership between the defendant Hui Qingxiang and other shareholders. Hui Qingxiang served as the Chairman and General Manager of the company. The defendant Chen Chuang served as the Executive Deputy General Manager and Marketing Manager, and as the person in charge of the Xi'an Branch (Office), specifically responsible for marketing matters in Xi'an. The defendant Feng Zhenda participated in tower space marketing in the Xi'an area from 2001 onwards, became the Marketing Director of the company in March 2003, contracted the tower space marketing in the Xi'an area, and received sales expenses of 28% to 30% of the sales amount.

To address funding difficulties, the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company, in violation of the relevant regulations on the sale of national cemeteries and under the manipulation of the defendants Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, Feng Zhenda, and others, illegally absorbed public funds. The main method was to divide the tower spaces within its park, intended for placing the ashes of the deceased, into two types: usage type (selected position) and investment type (unselected position). The company engaged in large-scale false advertising to the public, falsely claiming that purchasing investment-type tower spaces could preserve and increase value, and promised that within the period specified in the tower space purchase contract, name changes and order cancellations were allowed. To deceive the public, without any basis, the company irregularly and arbitrarily increased tower space prices, published price adjustment information to customers, creating a false impression of value appreciation, and also publicized the company's previous order cancellations to attract the public to purchase. Under the manipulation of Hui Qingxiang and others, the above conduct was mainly carried out in the Xi'an area. From April 1998 to August 2005, during the period when Hui Qingxiang served as General Manager and Chen Chuang served as the person in charge of the Xi'an Branch (Office), the number of victims in the Xi'an area who purchased investment-type tower spaces reached 4,334 persons, and Youhu Tower Park Company illegally absorbed over RMB 96.98 million in public funds. Additionally, due to severe funding shortages, Hui Qingxiang also decided to borrow funds at high interest rates from the company's internal employees and the general public. From December 1998 to July 2006, Youhu Tower Park Company borrowed from over 180 persons/times, with a total amount exceeding RMB 10.98 million. In total, Youhu Tower Park Company illegally absorbed over RMB 107 million in public deposits. Hui Qingxiang, as the Chairman and General Manager of the company, led, planned, and organized the company's implementation of the criminal act of illegally absorbing public deposits and was the directly responsible supervisor; Chen Chuang, as the Executive Deputy General Manager and Marketing Manager, participated in the company's illegal absorption of over RMB 96.98 million in public deposits; Feng Zhenda, as the Marketing Director of the company, participated in the company's illegal absorption of over RMB 26.32 million in public deposits during his term of office. Both were directly responsible persons.

During his tenure as the Chairman and General Manager of the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company, the defendant Hui Qingxiang, on November 10, 2003 and August 30, 2004, twice instructed the defendant Chen Chuang, who was then the person in charge of the company's Xi'an Office, to transfer RMB 4 million from the company's tower space sales revenue in Xi'an to the personal account of Qiu Jianxiong in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, as an investment for the joint operation of "Yijiangnan Catering Co., Ltd." by Hui Qingxiang's wife Ge Lihua and Qiu Jianxiong. After the case was uncovered, RMB 2 million of the misappropriated funds were recovered.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence, which was subject to cross-examination in court: the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company's corporate legal person business license, industrial and commercial registration materials, and the business license of its Xi'an Office; Letter No. (2006) 65 from the Weinan Civil Affairs Bureau; letters from the public; the public security authorities' case-solving report; the "Internal Subscription Regulations for Tower Spaces of Weinan Youhu Tower Park"; testimony of witnesses You Xiaobin, Sun Yi, Liu Li, Ren Xueqin, Liu Rongfang, Zhao Qingyan, Dong Guozhong, and Gao Peng; 68 promotional materials distributed by Youhu Tower Park Company to the victimized public, including "Q&A" and "Notice to Customers"; statements of Liu Wenyi, Ma Xiping, Jiang Jinsuo, Shen Jianming, and Wu Zhongjian, as well as loan agreements and IOUs; the "Tower Space Price List" and "Price Adjustment Notice" evidence; tower space purchase application forms and copies of permanent use certificates; statistical tables prepared by the public security authorities, explanations regarding the order cancellation situation, and account books and loan agreements extracted from Youhu Tower Park Company; confessions of the defendants Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda; and evidence from witnesses Chen Chuang, Qiu Jianxiong, Cao Ming, Ge Lihua, Su Fei, and Gao Jing; copies of original fund flow documents from the Xi'an Branch of China Merchants Bank; transaction details of Qiu Jianxiong's bank card issued by the Wuxi Branch of China Merchants Bank; credit slips from the Wuxi Commercial Bank; and seizure lists from the public security authorities. The evidence is sufficient to prove the above.

The Weinan Intermediate People's Court held:

Article 176 of the Criminal Law provides: "Whoever illegally absorbs public deposits or disguises the absorption of public deposits, thereby disrupting the financial order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than RMB 20,000 but not more than RMB 200,000; if the amount is huge or if there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than RMB 50,000 but not more than RMB 500,000. Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible persons shall be punished in accordance with the preceding paragraph." Article 4 of the State Council's "Measures for the Banning of Illegal Financial Institutions and Illegal Financial Business Activities" (hereinafter referred to as the Banning Measures) provides: "The term 'illegal financial business activities' as used in these Measures refers to the following activities engaged in without approval from the People's Bank of China: (1) illegally absorbing public deposits or disguising the absorption of public deposits; (2) without lawful approval, in any name, conducting illegal fundraising from an unspecified public audience; (3) illegally granting loans, conducting settlement, bill discounting, fund lending, trust investment, financial leasing, financing guarantees, foreign exchange trading; (4) other illegal financial business activities determined by the People's Bank of China. The term 'illegal absorption of public deposits' as used in the preceding paragraph refers to activities that, without approval from the People's Bank of China, absorb funds from an unspecified public audience, issue certificates, and promise to repay principal and interest within a specified period. The term 'disguised absorption of public deposits' refers to activities that, without approval from the People's Bank of China, absorb funds from an unspecified public audience not in the name of absorbing public deposits, but promise to perform obligations of the same nature as those of absorbing public deposits."

Based on the facts found in this case, when the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company sold its so-called investment-type tower spaces, it falsely advertised that purchasing investment-type tower spaces could preserve and increase value. Without any basis, it irregularly and arbitrarily increased tower space prices, published the price adjustment information to the public, creating a false impression of value appreciation. It also publicized the company's previous order cancellations to attract the public to purchase. The company also promised to handle name changes and order cancellations within the period specified in the contract, effectively agreeing to "repay principal and pay interest." In fact, Youhu Tower Park Company did carry out a large number of order cancellations and heavily advertised this fact to deceive more members of the public into purchasing tower spaces. The fundamental purpose of Youhu Tower Park Company's above conduct in selling investment-type tower spaces was to solve the company's funding shortage by illegally absorbing public funds. The obligations it promised to perform to customers who purchased investment-type tower spaces fully met the characteristics of disguised absorption of public deposits. Additionally, Youhu Tower Park Company also borrowed funds from individuals and enterprises through agreements, stipulating high interest rates, which also met the characteristics of illegal absorption of public deposits.

The defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company, without approval from the People's Bank of China, illegally absorbed public deposits in a huge amount, seriously disrupting the financial order. Its conduct constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. Hui Qingxiang, as the Chairman and General Manager of the company, led, planned, and organized the company's implementation of the criminal act of illegally absorbing public deposits and was the directly responsible supervisor. His conduct constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. The defendant Chen Chuang, as the Executive Deputy General Manager and Marketing Manager, specifically implemented the company's tower space marketing activities in Xi'an and was a directly responsible person. Feng Zhenda, as the Marketing Director of the company, participated in the company's tower space sales during his term of office and was also a directly responsible person. The conduct of both defendants constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The facts that the defendant Hui Qingxiang used RMB 4 million from the tower space sales proceeds of the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company for personal profit-making activities are clear and the evidence is sufficient. After the establishment and registration of Youhu Tower Park Company, the company's assets became independent from each contributor. Even a company shareholder cannot arbitrarily appropriate or misappropriate assets. The agreements on profit distribution and operations reached between Hui Qingxiang and other shareholders did not mean that Hui Qingxiang could arbitrarily dispose of the company's property. Therefore, Hui Qingxiang's act of using RMB 4 million from the tower space sales proceeds of Youhu Tower Park Company as an investment for the joint operation of "Yijiangnan Catering Co., Ltd." by his wife Ge Lihua and another person constituted the crime of misappropriating funds. Hui Qingxiang's confession after the public security authorities had already learned of the facts of the misappropriation of funds did not constitute voluntary surrender. The defendant Chen Chuang reported to the public security authorities the clues regarding Hui Qingxiang's crime of misappropriating funds, leading to the detection of Hui Qingxiang's crime, and thus constituted meritorious performance.

In conclusion, the conduct of the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company in this case constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits, and the amount was huge. The defendant Hui Qingxiang, as the directly responsible supervisor, should also be held criminally liable for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. Hui Qingxiang used his position as the Chairman and General Manager of Youhu Tower Park Company to misappropriate the company's funds for personal business activities, misappropriating a huge amount of company funds. His conduct constituted the crime of misappropriating funds and should be punished for multiple crimes according to law. The defendant Chen Chuang, as a directly responsible person, should be held criminally liable for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. In view of his meritorious performance, he should be given a lighter punishment according to law. The defendant Feng Zhenda was also a directly responsible person and should be held criminally liable for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. In view of his shorter duration of participation in the unit's crime and his lesser role, he should be given a lighter punishment. Youhu Tower Park Company used the illegally absorbed public deposits for the construction of the tower park and the company's daily operations. Therefore, all property derived from the company's crime of illegally absorbing public deposits should be recovered according to law and returned to the victims. The income of Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda from the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits by Youhu Tower Park Company also constituted illegal gains and should be recovered according to law and returned to the victims. Accordingly, on June 5, 2007, the Weinan Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company is convicted of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and is sentenced to a fine of RMB 500,000.
2. The defendant Hui Qingxiang is convicted of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and sentenced to five years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 400,000; he is convicted of the crime of misappropriating funds and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment. The combined sentence is eleven years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 400,000.
3. The defendant Chen Chuang is convicted of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and sentenced to three years' imprisonment, suspended for five years, and a fine of RMB 200,000.
4. The defendant Feng Zhenda is convicted of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and sentenced to three years' imprisonment, suspended for five years, and a fine of RMB 100,000.
5. All property derived from the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits by the defendant unit Youhu Tower Park Company and the defendants Hui Qingxiang, Chen Chuang, and Feng Zhenda shall be recovered according to law and returned to the victims.
6. The stolen funds of RMB 4 million misappropriated by the defendant Hui Qingxiang shall be recovered according to law and returned.

Both Youhu Tower Park Company and Hui Qingxiang were dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment and appealed to the Shaanxi High People's Court.

The appellant Youhu Tayuan Company argued that it entered into sales contracts with each niche purchaser on a voluntary and equal basis, and never signed any so-called investment-type contracts with anyone. The company's sale of niches does not meet the characteristics of "disguised absorption of public deposits" as stipulated in Article 4 of the Measures for Banning Illegal Financial Institutions and Illegal Financial Activities (the "Prohibition Measures"). Therefore, the company's conduct in this case does not constitute the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The appellant Hui Qingxiang argued that: First, the conduct of the appellant Youhu Tayuan Company in selling niches and borrowing funds does not meet the constitutive elements of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. Consequently, the actions he performed in fulfilling his duties within the company also do not constitute that crime. Second, Youhu Tayuan Company effectively had no shareholders' meeting; instead, he exercised the powers of the shareholders' meeting. He was authorized to use RMB 4 million of the company's funds and did not dispose of them privately or arbitrarily. Therefore, his conduct does not constitute the crime of misappropriating funds. Third, on October 31, 2006, after being criminally detained on suspicion of the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits, he voluntarily confessed to using RMB 4 million of company funds for personal investment. If this conduct is found to constitute the crime of misappropriating funds, he should also be found to have voluntarily surrendered.

Upon second-instance trial, the Shaanxi High People's Court confirmed the facts found in the first instance.

The Shaanxi High People's Court held in its second-instance judgment as follows:

Pursuant to the Prohibition Measures, illegally absorbing public deposits refers to activities of absorbing funds from unspecified members of the public without approval from the People's Bank of China, issuing vouchers, and promising to repay principal and interest within a specified period. Disguised absorption of public deposits refers to activities of absorbing funds from unspecified members of the public without approval from the People's Bank of China, not under the name of absorbing public deposits, but promising to perform obligations of the same nature as absorbing public deposits. In this case, the contracts signed between Youhu Tayuan Company and its customers were superficially niche sales contracts, but both parties explicitly agreed in the contracts that Youhu Tayuan Company was obligated to repay the principal and pay profits to the customers purchasing niches within a two-year period. Furthermore, the so-called "investment-type" niches offered by the company did not correspond to the ashes of any specific deceased person. The company promised either to pay annual profits according to the niche sales contract or to allow name changes and redemption. Redemption meant that Youhu Tayuan Company would repurchase the niche at market price. Due to the company's deceptive practices, the price of investment-type niches was irregularly and continuously raised without any basis. Therefore, upon redemption, Youhu Tayuan Company, in addition to refunding the original purchase price to the customer, also had to pay the appreciated portion, which was in effect a disguised form of "repayment of principal and interest." Consequently, the aforementioned conduct of Youhu Tayuan Company meets the characteristics of disguised absorption of public deposits as stipulated in Article 4 of the Prohibition Measures and constitutes the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. The appellant's grounds for appeal are unsustainable and are not adopted.

The appellant Youhu Tayuan Company, without approval from the competent financial authority, adopted the methods of selling investment-type niches to the public, promising redemption upon maturity, and borrowing funds from the public at high interest rates, thereby disguisedly absorbing public deposits. The amount involved was huge, the consequences were serious, and it severely disrupted financial and social order. Its conduct has constituted the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and shall be punished according to law. The appellant Hui Qingxiang, as the company's legal representative and general manager, directly participated in, organized, and led all of the company's criminal activities. He was the directly responsible supervisor in the unit crime and, according to law, committed the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits. The defendant at first instance, Chen Chuang, as the person in charge of the company's Xi'an office, organized and led the company's activities of illegally absorbing public deposits in the Xi'an area. He was also a directly responsible supervisor in the unit crime. The defendant at first instance, Feng Zhenda, was a directly responsible person in the unit crime. All shall be convicted and punished for the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The appellant Youhu Tayuan Company is a limited liability company lawfully registered and established, possessing independent property and able to bear responsibility independently as a legal person. The company's sales revenue constitutes independent legal person property. Without a decision by the company's decision-making body, no individual may dispose of it at will. The appellant Hui Qingxiang, by taking advantage of his position, arbitrarily used RMB 4 million of the company's funds for personal profit-making activities. His conduct constitutes the crime of misappropriating funds. The public security organs, through a report by the defendant at first instance, Chen Chuang, had already learned of the facts of Hui Qingxiang's misappropriation of funds on October 19, 2006. Hui Qingxiang only confessed to the relevant criminal facts under interrogation by the public security organs after being criminally detained on October 31 of the same year. This does not meet the statutory conditions for voluntary surrender.

In summary, the grounds of appeal raised by the appellants Youhu Tayuan Company and Hui Qingxiang are all unsustainable and are not adopted. The first-instance judgment's classification of the defendant at first instance, Chen Chuang, as a directly responsible person is improper; he should be classified as a directly responsible supervisor. The facts found in the first-instance judgment are basically clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the convictions are accurate, the sentences are appropriate, and the trial procedures are lawful. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 189 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Shaanxi High People's Court ruled on September 21, 2007, as follows:

Dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

This ruling is final.
